turns.text: Lloyd, my laptop fan is screaming again. Did you check the temperature logs from last night?
I did. It hit 95C around 2 AM while you were compiling that C++ project. I recommend throttling the CPU or cleaning the vents soon.

Great. I'll take a can of compressed air to it this weekend. By the way, I've been reading up on that new robot model, Octo. It's an open-source transformer-based diffusion policy pretrained on 800k Open X-Embodiment episodes.
That's a significant dataset. Open X-Embodiment really helps with generalization.
Exactly. I'm trying to decide if I should try fine-tuning it on my own data later.
With that much pretraining data, you might get good results with just a few hundred episodes of your own.
Good to know. Anyway, did the package with the new keyboard switches arrive?
Yes, it was delivered at 10:15 AM. It's on your porch.
Hey Lloyd, I'm stuck on this dinner plan. Should I make the pasta salad or just order pizza?
Given the forecast of rain, maybe staying in is better. Pasta salad is easier to prep ahead.

True. I'll go with the salad. On another note, I've been comparing models for the lab meeting. I found out that Octo is identified as a close competitor to Tube Diffusion Policy in the diffusion-based VLA slot.
That makes sense given their similar architectures and training paradigms.
Yeah, the benchmark numbers are pretty close too. I might end up using it for the comparison slide.
It should provide a solid baseline for your presentation.
Thanks. Also, did you see the email about the server maintenance?
Yes, it's scheduled for this Sunday at 2 AM. I've added it to your calendar.
